name: @forgeax/engine-input
description: Frame-start scanned, frozen InputSnapshot Resource (logical keyboard key and physical code held/press/release edges + mouse.position/movementDelta + mouse.button(0|1|2)) + browser PointerLock backend for forgeax-engine.

bundle-size.reason: Measured 16132 B gzip with the bounded dual-rumble producer and Host actuator lifecycle (up from the prior 12069 B input surface); 17600 B allows approximately 10% headroom for this explicit capability addition. Physical-device validation remains pending; this is a byte-size budget, not haptic performance acceptance.

fps.reason: library package, no runtime canvas; fps is reported by hello-* / learn-render apps that consume engine.input.snapshot()

bench.reason: Contract load benchmark: bun packages/input/scripts/benchmark-feedback.ts. Host dispatch and POD roundtrip report 1/2/4 targets at idle, event and unchanged 32-command burst load. This report is not the metric registry benchmark harness and does not establish physical throughput; full App frame and hardware acceptance remain required.

gate.reason: no package-level binary gate; AC-07 surface coverage runs as part of pnpm test:unit + tsc -b

spike-report.reason: not a spike package; this is a production MVP per plan-strategy D-5 (input internalisation minimal surface)
